# libmacaroons verifier tests

The `.vtest` files are copied unchanged from [rescrv/libmacaroons](https://github.com/rescrv/libmacaroons) `test/unit/` at commit `ca0211d` (2021-02-19), under its BSD license in `LICENSE`. Each names a root key, the exact predicates a verifier satisfies, a serialized macaroon (base64 of libmacaroons' serialization), and whether libmacaroons authorizes it.
